note: The morning exercise at Bãi Trước (plan 0023, R9d, PT-58). Each group stands on the paved promenade at the edge of the park (the pedestrian way along the beach). "leader_at" is the point of the leader (x, z of the game), and "facing" the direction from the leader to the group. The people stand in rows of "per_row" in front of the leader, "across" meters apart, the first row "first_row" meters from the leader and the next rows "row_gap" meters behind it, as the exercise blueprint of World. Each person starts the loop of the routine at a time of its own. "from" and "to" are the times of the group. The tai chi group with fans waits for World (Q8).
